Waypoint 4, Sa Detalye

Bank Finance vs Pag-IBIG Finance

Two main paths to owning a home — learn the difference before you choose.

Bank Finance

  • ✓Mas mabilis ang processing time
  • ✓Mas mataas na loanable amount
  • ✓Puwedeng umabot hanggang 25 taon ang bayaran
  • ✓Market-based ang interest rates
VS

Pag-IBIG Finance

  • ✓Government-backed na programa
  • ✓Mas mababang interest rates
  • ✓Puwedeng umabot hanggang 30 taon ang bayaran
  • ✓Fixed ang interest rates
